name: select-features
notes: Reads both classes' per-arm walk-forward summaries (written by workflow-select-sequence.json and workflow-select-tabular.json), applies the keep rule (z standard errors of the paired per-fold difference, at least min_folds folds) and writes selected-features-sequence.json, selected-features-tabular.json and feature-selection-disagreements.json into this run's artifacts/select directory. Nothing is fitted; the files are run outputs and are never committed. Run from children/crypto_trading after both workflows finish: `python -m dskit.pipeline run configs/select-features.json --asof 2026-05-01 --adapter crypto_trading`. The zoo configs read the two files in a later wave.

sequence.notes: The sequence batch's root (its manifest's work_dir), then the lane's own work dir and the layout's runs directory, {arm} standing for the lane; a test pins the three together.

tabular.notes: The tabular batch's root (its manifest's work_dir), then the lane's own work dir and the layout's runs directory, {arm} standing for the lane; a test pins the three together.

select.notes: arms_file is the arm vocabulary; the column list is probed from MinuteFeatures with these params (assets only, so the node's defaults: the same columns the lanes produced). z = 1 is the one-standard-error rule, liberal toward keeping because a false drop costs signal and a false keep costs one column; min_folds = 8 refuses a standard error from too few folds. Raise z to be stricter. A `selected` lane under either runs directory is read as the check arm.

outputs.notes: Empty = ./pipeline_runs under the invoking cwd. Placement is not identity (hash-excluded).
